segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, yeah, I’m calling back about ticket 48291. Our admin account, admin@northlakeprint.com, locked again this morning, same as last week. This is the second time I’ve reached out on this and the earlier reset didn’t actually fix it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m sorry you’re dealing with it again. Let me pull up 48291 in the ticketing system. One moment.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We were able to get in after the password reset on Tuesday, then it was fine for maybe three days, and today at 8:17 a.m. Central it started saying too many attempts again.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I see the prior notes. The account was unlocked on July 23, and there was a note to monitor failed sign-ins. I’m checking the admin console now for the recent lockout entries.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, and just to be clear, nobody here is trying the wrong password over and over. It’s just me and Dana who use that login for provisioning, and we’ve been careful.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Understood. I’m seeing multiple failed auth attempts against that admin address overnight, starting around 2:06 a.m. Central, but the source details are not fully populated in this view. I can unlock the account again right now so you’re not blocked.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please do. We have six new hires starting Monday and I need to finish setting up their users today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, the account is unlocked. Can you try signing in while we’re on the line?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, one sec. Okay, I’m in now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Good. For the longer fix, I’m going to add the overnight auth pattern to the ticket and send it to our access team. I don’t want to call it resolved yet since it has come back after the last unlock.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine, but we need something more than another reset. If it locks again over the weekend, we’re stuck.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I hear you. I’ll mark it as recurring and request review today. You’ll get an update on ticket 48291 by 3 p.m. Pacific, even if the answer is still in progress.
